definitions.occupancy: Geometric containment by minimum-image squared distance <= radius squared. Each patch counts independently; overlaps double-count. fractionInsideAnyPatch counts the union once, null for an empty population.
definitions.displacement: Each tick compares pre-step and post-step positions of IDs present at both endpoints, excluding births and deaths. Minimum-image Euclidean displacement in world widths. The aggregate weights each surviving-ID pair equally; null when no pairs.
definitions.contacts: First geometrically containing patch in fixed food-array order, or outside (-1). This matches feeding patch priority but does not assert food was consumed. Entries, exits and switches compare surviving IDs before and after a tick, including patch motion. Contact changes do not establish regrouping or following.
definitions.intervalStorage: Motion and contact measures are computed every tick, then stored as consecutive 100-tick interval sums and matched-pair weighted means; the final interval ends at extinction if earlier. Interval contactTransitions are sparse [priorPatchIndex, nextPatchIndex, count] triples with -1 for outside. No per-tick rows are retained.
definitions.contactTransitions: 10x10 aggregate matrix: row is prior contact, column is new contact. Index 0 means outside; indices 1-9 mean patch indices 0-8. Includes unchanged contacts. Sum equals matchedSurvivingIdPairs.
definitions.populationRange: Overall includes tick zero. After1000 includes completed ticks strictly greater than 1000, null if none. Ranges include an extinction tick when reached.
definitions.clocks: scheduledTargetTick is 6000. Each run stops at extinction; finishedTick and patches freeze there. Histories include tick zero, every100 completed ticks, and extinction. No synthetic later zero samples.
definitions.caps: Ending population equals the fixed population cap at a completed tick. Cap fraction divides by completed ticks.
definitions.interpretation: Supplied food steering and moving patches are engineered. These descriptive measures do not prove adaptation, autonomous following, or group regrouping. Replay promises apply within one runtime only.
